def restore_integers(n, parents, counts):
    from collections import defaultdict, deque
    
    # Build the tree
    tree = defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        if parents[i - 1] != 0:
            tree[parents[i - 1]].append(i)
    
    # Function to perform DFS and assign values
    def dfs(node):
        if not tree[node]:
            return [1]
        
        values = []
        for child in tree[node]:
            child_values = dfs(child)
            values.extend(child_values)
        
        # Sort the values to assign the smallest available value to the current node
        values.sort()
        c_i = counts[node - 1]
        a_i = values[c_i]
        
        # Insert a_i into the sorted list
        values.insert(c_i, a_i)
        
        return values
    
    # Start DFS from the root (node 1)
    root_values = dfs(1)
    
    # Check if the root value is valid
    if root_values[0] != 1:
        return "NO"
    
    return "YES", root_values
